name: fitness-connector
description: Private connectors for a workspace-owned Fitness database.

interface.longDescription: Fitness Connector reads and writes the workspace-owned Fitness database through bounded adapters for Xunji, SynFit, Apple Calendar, and Apple Health. It consumes governed Fitness v5 sessions but does not own training rules or personal records.
defaultPrompt: Use $fitness-connector to preview or publish one confirmed Fitness v5.1 half-Block release as a unified batch
Use $fitness-connector to refresh Xunji or Apple Health facts into my Fitness workspace
